title: Data Analyst (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 4 years of experience as a Data Analyst
  • Proven experience with Python, Power BI, and Google Analytics
  • Professional proficiency in English (B2)
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Senior AI Technical Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior AI Technical Project Manager .


In this role you will:

Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered digital initiatives across Quality and CMC operations. This role will drive cross-functional execution of AI use cases, ensuring alignment between Digital, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Data Science teams.

The AI TPM will be responsible for translating business needs into scalable, compliant AI solutions while managing technical dependencies, governance, risk, and value realization in a regulated (GxP) environment.

  • Lead complex AI programs from ideation through deployment and scaling.
  • Develop and manage program roadmaps, milestones, risks, and KPIs.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Data Science, IT, Quality, Manufacturing, Vendors).
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise digital and AI strategy.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases (e.g., deviations, CAPA prediction, batch analytics, document intelligence).
  • Oversee model development lifecycle (data readiness, training, validation, deployment).
  • Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
  • Governance & Compliance (GxP Focus)Embed AI governance frameworks (model validation, explainability, bias monitoring).
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, GAMP5, CSA).
  • Drive documentation for audit readiness and inspection preparedness.
  • Manage data integrity standards (ALCOA+).
  • Understand system architecture (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, data platforms).
  • Manage integration dependencies across enterprise systems. Partner with cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Oversee vendor technical performance.
  • Identify technical and regulatory risks early and drive mitigation.
  • Manage change adoption within Quality and CMC functions.
  • Develop communication plans for executive and operational stakeholders.
  • Define measurable KPIs (cycle time reduction, deviation reduction, automation rate).
  • Track ROI and business impact of AI initiatives.
  • Ensure sustainable scaling of successful pilots.


We have some requirements:

  • Previous experience in Technical Program Management, Digital Transformation, or Engineering Program Delivery.
  • Previous experience leading AI/ML or advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Experience in regulated industries (Pharma, Biotech, Medical Devices).
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and data governance.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, etc.).
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  • Fluent English

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity

  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

We encourage anyone interested to build a career in TCS to participate in our recruitment & selection process.


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.




Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Perfil Engenheiro de dados Sênior com experiência em projetos de alta criticidade no setor financeiro.

Especialista em construção, manutenção e evolução de motores de decisão utilizando FICO DMPS e FICO Blaze Advisor, com foco em orquestração de dados e integrações via APEIs Rest. Possuir Expertise em manipulação de grandes volumes de dados para produtos de credito. (Consignado, imobiliário e consórcio) e vivência em ambientes Cloud AWS, operando com Athena, Aurora e Keyspaces para garantir performance e rastreabilidade operacional. Capacidade técnica na sustentação de sistemas críticos e implementação de politicas de decisão para grandes players bancários.



HardSkill


Requisitos Técnicos imprescindíveis:

FICO DMPS / Braze Advisor

AWS (Atena, Aurora, Keyspaces)

Python / JavaScript / SQL



SoftSkills


Trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade, senso de urgência

Comunicativo comunicar se com clareza, relacionar-se bem com os demais membros do time

Autodisciplinado fazer a gestão de suas tarefas, ser organizado

Colaborativo deve ajudar o time, sempre que necessário e possível

Proativo com senso de dono


TRABALHE NA MINSAIT


  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).
  • Vale Refeição no cartão Flash Benefícios.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Integramos o Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index (GEI) 2021 em termos de diversidade e igualdade de gênero.

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Profissional focado na experiência do usuário, responsável por integrar novas funcionalidades de forma fluida e intuitiva nos aplicativos bancários.

title: Desenvolvedor Tasy
description:
Curte unir tecnologia, saúde e impacto real na vida das pessoas? Como Consultor Desenvolvedor Tasy EMR, você será peça-chave na evolução de soluções para hospitais e clínicas, ajudando a transformar a jornada de cuidado em algo mais ágil, seguro e inteligente.

Você vai atuar em uma empresa focada em inovação em saúde, com times multidisciplinares, ambiente colaborativo e espaço para propor melhorias de verdade.

  • Desenvolver, parametrizar e customizar módulos no Tasy EMR.
  • Levantar requisitos com áreas de negócio e traduzir em soluções técnicas.
  • Construir integrações (interfaces) entre Tasy e outros sistemas.
  • Realizar testes, homologação e suporte pós-implantação.
  • Documentar soluções, fluxos e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar usuários-chave em treinamentos e dúvidas.
  • Sugerir melhorias contínuas em processos e sistemas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada com Tasy EMR (desenvolvimento, parametrização ou consultoria).
  • Vivência em ambiente hospitalar ou de saúde suplementar.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados (SQL) para consultas e ajustes.
  • Experiência com análise de requisitos e desenho de processos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com integrações HL7, webservices, APIs ou ESB.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de implantação ou migração de Tasy.
  • Noções de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em outros sistemas de gestão hospitalar/EMR.
  • Formação em TI, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Saúde ou áreas correlatas.

title: Analista de Sistemas Mainframe
description:
Atribuições:

  • Levantar requisitos do negócio junto às áreas solicitantes para o entendimento e mapeamento das necessidades;
  • Executar o desenvolvimento do projeto físico, por meio da especificação e codificação de programas, segundo modelo definido em conjunto com a área de arquitetura de sistemas, em projetos ou sustentação dos sistemas;
  • Desenvolver projetos ou atendimentos de alta complexidade, compreendendo a análise da solicitação, definição de requisitos técnicos e prazo e observando os padrões estabelecidos, para aprovação do usuário.
  • Executar testes individuais e integrados de programas e sistemas, incluindo Roteiros de teste e preparação da massa de dados, para verificação de padrões de funcionamento e do atendimento à solicitação do usuário;
  • Homologar processos dos sistemas junto aos usuários, prestando apoio técnico, orientando-os na sua operacionalização e validação;
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, apoiando a equipe de operação, monitorando o resultado produzido, para assegurar o perfeito funcionamento;
  • Identificar possíveis pontos de problemas de infraestrutura, performance ou falhas de sistemas e propor soluções/melhorias, de modo a eliminar problemas no ambiente a curto/médio/longo prazo.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade e desempenho de sistemas, serviços e componentes, objetivando a melhoria contínua da qualidade dos serviços prestados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de soluções e projetos de TI;
  • Experiência nas várias fases de um projeto de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;
  • Atuação com modelagem de Banco de Dados Relacional;
  • Conhecimento ambiente IBM, desenvolvimento em linguagem Cobol e Banco de Dados DB2;
  • Conhecimentos em processos Devops, qualidade de código, testes unitários;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
A Avenue Code é uma consultoria global de tecnologia especializada em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software e soluções de alta performance para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo. Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.


Sobre a posição:

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders. Essa pessoa é responsável por garantir a excelência na entrega, remover impedimentos, apoiar decisões estratégicas e assegurar que a cultura, os objetivos e a estratégia do cliente sejam bem compreendidos e disseminados dentro do time. Além disso, o papel tem forte atuação em gestão de pessoas, acompanhamento de performance e relacionamento com o cliente, contribuindo para a saúde da conta e identificação de oportunidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e garantir a performance dos times alocados no cliente
  • Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à entrega
  • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios de performance, KPIs, riscos e indicadores da conta
  • Conduzir processos de onboarding do time (Avenue Code e cliente)
  • Realizar entrevistas com foco em culture fit
  • Conduzir avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks contínuos e reuniões 1:1
  • Criar e acompanhar planos de desenvolvimento individuais (PDI)
  • Apoiar ações de retenção, promoções, negociações e movimentações internas
  • Controlar horas trabalhadas e apoiar a gestão de capacidade do time
  • Atuar em reuniões de attrition e análise de riscos de turnover
  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas



Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (excelente comunicação verbal e escrita)
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas
  • Experiência no relacionamento direto com clientes
  • Background técnico, preferencialmente em desenvolvimento de software
  • Habilidade de negociação
  • Experiência com relatórios de performance e indicadores de negócio


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial
  • Conhecimento em OKRs
  • Experiência com métricas de performance
  • Familiaridade com NPS



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• 5–6+ years of experience as a Data Scientist • 1–2 years of hands-on experience with Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Large Language Models (LLMs) • Strong Python skills, with the ability to integrate code into existing engineering frameworks and hand off to engineering for production deployment • Proficiency with GitHub and version control workflows • Experience with database structures and cloud computing (any provider is acceptable)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Prior working experience with LangGraph


Job Description


You’ll work closely with two Principal Data Scientists and own a feature within a broader education technology initiative. Your tasks will be assigned via Jira by a project manager, and you’ll collaborate with engineering to push code into production. While you won’t be responsible for defining features, you’ll execute on them independently, relying on the Principal Data Scientist for guidance and feedback. Expect 1–2 scrums per week, formal data process reviews (but no formal code reviews), and a fast-paced environment focused on delivering RAG-based AI solutions that support clients.

title: Data Analyst (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 4 years of experience as a Data Analyst
  • Proven experience with Python, Power BI, and Google Analytics
  • Professional proficiency in English (B2)
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Sênior #998062
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que procuramos?

Perfil autônomo, independente e proativo , com responsabilidade sobre as soluções do início ao fim. Experiência sólida com Node.js, JavaScript e TypeScript , além de conhecimento em Java com Springboot .


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em Node.js / JavaScript / TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento em Springboot / Java.
  • Familiaridade com microserviços.
  • Habilidade em gerenciamento de APIs e MQ.
  • Experiência com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle / PL/SQL.
  • Práticas de DevOps.
  • Experiência com OpenShift / Kubernetes (k8s).
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Azure.


Será um diferencial:

  • Capacidade de desenhar arquitetura sistêmica.
  • Agnóstico a tecnologia e linguagem de programação, pois entendemos que sabendo os conceitos, não importa a ferramenta utilizada.
  • Já construiu ambientes e entendesse de conceitos de rede e protocolos de comunicação.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tunning de aplicações.
  • Escrevesse em linguagem de script.
  • Já trabalhou com Metodologia Ágil.
  • Incessante na aprendizagem.


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Evoluir e otimizar soluções existentes, sempre garantindo alta escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Qualidade de Código: Implementar e promover práticas de testes rigorosos para assegurar a qualidade do software.
  • Colaboração em Requisitos: Trabalhar diretamente com usuários para compreender e documentar requisitos, e colaborar com a equipe no processo de implementação, desde o código até a produção.
  • Investigação de Problemas: Auxiliar na análise e resolução de falhas potenciais em sistemas e processos, garantindo a estabilidade e a eficácia da operação.
  • Automação de Processos: Automatizar rotinas e processos, assegurando que sejam resilientes e eficientes.


Local de atuação? No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Sênior #998062
description:

Perfil autônomo, independente e proativo , com responsabilidade sobre as soluções do início ao fim. Experiência sólida com Node.js, JavaScript e TypeScript , além de conhecimento em Java com Springboot .


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em Node.js / JavaScript / TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento em Springboot / Java.
  • Familiaridade com microserviços.
  • Habilidade em gerenciamento de APIs e MQ.
  • Experiência com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle / PL/SQL.
  • Práticas de DevOps.
  • Experiência com OpenShift / Kubernetes (k8s).
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Azure.


Será um diferencial:

  • Capacidade de desenhar arquitetura sistêmica.
  • Agnóstico a tecnologia e linguagem de programação, pois entendemos que sabendo os conceitos, não importa a ferramenta utilizada.
  • Já construiu ambientes e entendesse de conceitos de rede e protocolos de comunicação.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tunning de aplicações.
  • Escrevesse em linguagem de script.
  • Já trabalhou com Metodologia Ágil.
  • Incessante na aprendizagem.


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Evoluir e otimizar soluções existentes, sempre garantindo alta escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Qualidade de Código: Implementar e promover práticas de testes rigorosos para assegurar a qualidade do software.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior AI Technical Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior AI Technical Project Manager .


In this role you will:

Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered digital initiatives across Quality and CMC operations. This role will drive cross-functional execution of AI use cases, ensuring alignment between Digital, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Data Science teams.

The AI TPM will be responsible for translating business needs into scalable, compliant AI solutions while managing technical dependencies, governance, risk, and value realization in a regulated (GxP) environment.

  • Lead complex AI programs from ideation through deployment and scaling.
  • Develop and manage program roadmaps, milestones, risks, and KPIs.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Data Science, IT, Quality, Manufacturing, Vendors).
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise digital and AI strategy.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases (e.g., deviations, CAPA prediction, batch analytics, document intelligence).
  • Oversee model development lifecycle (data readiness, training, validation, deployment).
  • Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
  • Governance & Compliance (GxP Focus)Embed AI governance frameworks (model validation, explainability, bias monitoring).
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, GAMP5, CSA).
  • Drive documentation for audit readiness and inspection preparedness.
  • Manage data integrity standards (ALCOA+).
  • Understand system architecture (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, data platforms).
  • Manage integration dependencies across enterprise systems. Partner with cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Oversee vendor technical performance.
  • Identify technical and regulatory risks early and drive mitigation.
  • Manage change adoption within Quality and CMC functions.
  • Develop communication plans for executive and operational stakeholders.
  • Define measurable KPIs (cycle time reduction, deviation reduction, automation rate).
  • Track ROI and business impact of AI initiatives.
  • Ensure sustainable scaling of successful pilots.


We have some requirements:

  • Previous experience in Technical Program Management, Digital Transformation, or Engineering Program Delivery.
  • Previous experience leading AI/ML or advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Experience in regulated industries (Pharma, Biotech, Medical Devices).

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

  • Portuguese as a first language.

title: Parceiro de vendas
description:
Seja um Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital, a Primeira TaxTech do Brasil.


Você é um consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com acesso a decisores C-level?

Quer oferecer aos seus clientes uma solução de alto impacto, sem custo inicial, e ainda gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita?

O Grupo AG Capital, a primeira e maior TaxTech do Brasil, está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos. Já recuperamos mais de R$ 8 bilhões em tributos para mais de 12.000 clientes, incluindo 15% das empresas listadas na B3, e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso.

Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária brasileira em fluxo de caixa e compliance para as empresas, através de tecnologia proprietária e uma metodologia exclusiva. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos parceiros que compartilhem da nossa visão e queiram crescer conosco.


Quem Buscamos? O Parceiro Ideal em 3 Dimensões:


1) Expertise e Acesso a Clientes Estratégicos:


Você é um especialista com reputação sólida em consultoria (contábil, tributária, RH), advocacia empresarial, tecnologia ou vendas; Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? Buscamos sua credibilidade e seu acesso ao mercado.


2) Alinhamento com um Modelo de Negócio Inovador:


Você acredita em um modelo onde o cliente só paga pelo sucesso, sem custos de entrada ou taxas de manutenção?

Nosso modelo de remuneração 100% no êxito é um dos nossos maiores diferenciais. Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero.


3) Mentalidade \"TaxTech\"


Você vê a tecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário.


O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria:


•Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.

•Modelo de Receita Atrativo: Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita, 100% comissionada sobre o sucesso das operações, sem limite de ganhos.

•Força da Marca Líder: Associe-se à marca que é referência no mercado, com metodologia validada, operação segurada pela Berkley e reconhecimento pela mídia e por grandes premiações (Exame, Deloitte, BTG Pactual).

•Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico.


Você se identifica com este perfil?


Se você é um profissional visionário, com uma carteira de clientes consolidada e o desejo de gerar um impacto financeiro real para seus clientes e para o seu negócio, queremos conversar com você.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Business Systems Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Data Architect – Snowflake || Brazil/Remote
description:
Data Architect – Snowflake

Advance hands-on SQL


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

• Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Staff AI Engineer | AI Orchestration & SDLC Automation para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil (Porto Alegre/RS ou São Paulo/RS)


O que você vai fazer

Estamos buscando uma pessoa que irá atuar como Staff-level Engineer para projetar e gerenciar uma camada de orquestração de IA incorporada em nossos pipelines de CI/CD, transformando a IA em uma capacidade de engenharia de software controlada e escalável.

Essa função é responsável por institucionalizar agentes de IA (começando com Devin), automatizando o ciclo de vida do software de ponta a ponta, preservando a propriedade e a responsabilidade humanas.


AI Orchestration & Architecture:

Projetar e implementar uma camada de orquestração de IA integrada ao pipeline de CI/CD.

Orquestrar agentes e habilidades de IA em todas as etapas do SDLC (design, desenvolvimento, teste, refatoração).

Definir como as sessões de IA são criadas, gerenciadas, versionadas, auditadas e revisadas.


Context Engineering at Scale:

Projetar mecanismos para provisionar automaticamente o contexto por projeto, incluindo:

  • Bases de código
  • Arquitetura e documentação
  • Padrões e políticas
  • Histórico de tickets e incidentes

Garantir que a IA opere com um contexto preciso, delimitado e em conformidade desde o primeiro dia.


SDLC Automation & Ticket Flow

Automatize fluxos de trabalho a partir de tickets do Jira:

  • Ingestão e classificação de tickets
  • Criação automática de sessões de IA
  • Vinculação de contexto e definição do escopo da tarefa
  • Ciclos de revisão e aprovação humana

Habilite a rastreabilidade de ticket → código → testes → implantação.


CI/CD Integration

Incorpore a orquestração de IA em pipelines de CI/CD para:

  • Geração e modificação de código
  • Geração e manutenção automatizadas de testes
  • Revisões de PR e verificações de qualidade
  • Verificações de conformidade e segurança

Garanta que os resultados da IA sejam governados, repetíveis e mensuráveis.


Devin Deployment & Scaling

• Liderar a implementação inicial do Devin em toda a organização.

• Definir padrões de uso, diretrizes e modelos de adoção.

• Garantir que o Devin evolua de uma ferramenta para uma capacidade de engenharia padronizada.


Measurement & Governance

  • Definir métricas para medir o impacto da IA na produtividade, qualidade e confiabilidade.
  • Garantir que toda a atividade de IA seja observável, auditável e alinhada com a governança corporativa.
  • Aprimorar continuamente a orquestração com base em resultados e feedback.


Technical Leadership

  • Atuar como responsável técnico pela IA dentro do SDLC (Ciclo de Vida de Desenvolvimento de Software).
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Plataforma, DevOps, QA (Garantia da Qualidade), Segurança e Arquitetura.
  • Orientar engenheiros seniores e definir as melhores práticas.


✅ O que buscamos em você

• Sólida experiência profissional em engenharia de software.

• Liderança técnica comprovada em nível de equipe/principal.

• Sólida experiência em engenharia de plataforma, CI/CD e ferramentas internas.

• Experiência na construção de sistemas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho.

• Experiência prática na integração de agentes de IA ou LLMs em pipelines de produção.

• Experiência em ambientes regulamentados de grande escala.

• Experiência em desenvolvimento.

Platform & Orchestration

• Design de pipelines CI/CD

• APIs, SDKs e frameworks de automação

• Observabilidade e auditabilidade


Applied AI

description:
About SEW

Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and IoT-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights:

  • 420+ global clients across the U.S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
  • Millions of users engaged monthly
  • 150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times


Searching for your dream job? We are a true global company that values building meaningful relationships and maintaining an enthusiastic work environment while fostering innovation and creativity. At SEW, we believe that everyone contributes to our success, and in return, we provide opportunities for them to learn new skills and build a rewarding professional career.


Summary

We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP’s core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
  • Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks
  • Define and execute integration strategies across SAP and non-SAP systems (APIs, events, middleware)
  • Design scalable, high-performance architectures that support enterprise and utility-specific requirements
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for complex initiatives, guiding development teams and solution partners
  • Ensure solutions align with SAP best practices, security standards, and long-term platform roadmaps
  • Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape
  • Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
  • Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly.


You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly , and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments.


  • Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments.
  • Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts.
  • Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations , including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices.
  • Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends.
  • Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines.
  • Solid reliability engineering experience , including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety.
  • Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform , including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation.
  • Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services , ensuring high availability and operational resilience.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation.
  • Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments.
  • Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation.
  • Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments.
  • Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts.
  • IaC background with Terraform , including environment separation and state management at scale.
  • Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:

São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;

  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;

title: Pessoa Gerente Financeira
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de PR e Marketing Tech da América Latina. Nós transformamos dados em decisões estratégicas. Com o uso de inteligência artificial e monitoramento de mídia de ponta, ajudamos marcas globais a entenderem sua reputação e o mercado em tempo real.

Somos movidos por inovação, mas o que realmente nos sustenta são as pessoas. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a tecnologia e a estratégia caminham juntas, seu lugar é aqui.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Gestão de Pessoas e Estrutura da Área:

Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional.

Faturamento (Billing):

Assegurar a acuracidade e escalabilidade do faturamento, garantindo aderência ao modelo de negócio (SaaS/recorrente), com foco em eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos.

Contas a Receber (AR) e Gestão de Inadimplência:

Definir estratégias e acompanhar indicadores de recebimento, atuando na redução de inadimplência, melhoria do ciclo de caixa e eficiência na conversão de receita em caixa.

Contas a Pagar (AP) e Tesouraria:

Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros.

Compras e Gestão de Custos:

Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores.

Controles Internos e Compliance:

Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos.

Análises Gerenciais e Interface com Diretoria:

Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica.

Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência:

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de áreas financeiras;
  • Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
  • Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets).


Também é legal se você tiver:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em empresas SaaS ou modelos de receita recorrente;
  • Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Experiência com estruturação de processos, automações e melhoria contínua;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores financeiros de SaaS (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, etc.);
  • Experiência em interação com investidores, auditorias ou governança corporativa.
