Ready to level up your career with international experience? Let's talk.

title: SAP Technical Lead
description:
About SEW

Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and IoT-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights:

  • 420+ global clients across the U.S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
  • Millions of users engaged monthly
  • 150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times


Searching for your dream job? We are a true global company that values building meaningful relationships and maintaining an enthusiastic work environment while fostering innovation and creativity. At SEW, we believe that everyone contributes to our success, and in return, we provide opportunities for them to learn new skills and build a rewarding professional career.


Summary

We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP’s core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
  • Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks
  • Define and execute integration strategies across SAP and non-SAP systems (APIs, events, middleware)
  • Design scalable, high-performance architectures that support enterprise and utility-specific requirements
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for complex initiatives, guiding development teams and solution partners
  • Ensure solutions align with SAP best practices, security standards, and long-term platform roadmaps
  • Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape
  • Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
  • Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns
  • Proven experience implementing clean core–compliant extensibility
  • Deep knowledge of SAP IS-U in utility enterprise environments
  • Experience with SAP Service Cloud V2 and SAP CX integrations
  • Solid understanding of SAP BTP, including extension, integration, and API management services
  • Strong background in system integration, performance tuning, and scalability
  • Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions
  • Utility industry experience
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Fluency in Spanish is highly required


\"SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.\"

2 vagas

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular)


Salary: $5,500 – $6,500 USD per month (based on experience)

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (EST)

Location: Fully remote (Latin America)


Latino Legends is conducting a search on behalf of one of our innovative, fast-growing clients in the marketing and digital delivery space.


Our client is a technology-driven marketing organization that builds and scales high-performance digital platforms for global brands. They specialize in developing advanced marketing systems, product delivery solutions, and integrated digital experiences that support microsites, social media, and complex backend operations. The company is known for embracing modern technologies, agile practices, and continuous innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to play a key role across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).


The Role


As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key contributor to the client’s technology team. You will go beyond implementation—helping architect, design, and scale applications that power a global digital ecosystem. From backend services to modern frontend interfaces, your work will directly impact performance, scalability, and user experience.


Technical Qualifications & Requirements


  • Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core/MVC, and Entity Framework. Experience designing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Frontend Expertise: Advanced experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Angular (v12+), including state management, component architecture, and performance optimization.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, plus cloud platforms such as Azure (preferred) or AWS/GCP. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Software Craftsmanship: Solid understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, unit testing/TDD, and Agile/SCRUM methodologies.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Comfortable mentoring teammates, participating in code reviews, and contributing to best practices within distributed teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect and develop scalable, high-quality applications using modern .NET and Angular frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality through documentation, testing, and peer reviews.
  • Research and implement new technologies to keep the platform modern and competitive.


Why Join This Opportunity?


  • Modern, cloud-native technology stack with minimal legacy constraints.
  • Collaborative, professional work environment with high technical standards.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
  • Strong work-life balance with PTO and recognized holidays.

  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support

  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Staff AI Engineer | AI Orchestration & SDLC Automation para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil (Porto Alegre/RS ou São Paulo/RS)


O que você vai fazer

Estamos buscando uma pessoa que irá atuar como Staff-level Engineer para projetar e gerenciar uma camada de orquestração de IA incorporada em nossos pipelines de CI/CD, transformando a IA em uma capacidade de engenharia de software controlada e escalável.

Essa função é responsável por institucionalizar agentes de IA (começando com Devin), automatizando o ciclo de vida do software de ponta a ponta, preservando a propriedade e a responsabilidade humanas.


AI Orchestration & Architecture:

Projetar e implementar uma camada de orquestração de IA integrada ao pipeline de CI/CD.

Orquestrar agentes e habilidades de IA em todas as etapas do SDLC (design, desenvolvimento, teste, refatoração).

Definir como as sessões de IA são criadas, gerenciadas, versionadas, auditadas e revisadas.


Context Engineering at Scale:

Projetar mecanismos para provisionar automaticamente o contexto por projeto, incluindo:

  • Bases de código
  • Arquitetura e documentação
  • Padrões e políticas
  • Histórico de tickets e incidentes

Garantir que a IA opere com um contexto preciso, delimitado e em conformidade desde o primeiro dia.


SDLC Automation & Ticket Flow

Automatize fluxos de trabalho a partir de tickets do Jira:

  • Ingestão e classificação de tickets
  • Criação automática de sessões de IA
  • Vinculação de contexto e definição do escopo da tarefa
  • Ciclos de revisão e aprovação humana

Habilite a rastreabilidade de ticket → código → testes → implantação.


CI/CD Integration

Incorpore a orquestração de IA em pipelines de CI/CD para:

  • Geração e modificação de código
  • Geração e manutenção automatizadas de testes
  • Revisões de PR e verificações de qualidade
  • Verificações de conformidade e segurança

Garanta que os resultados da IA sejam governados, repetíveis e mensuráveis.


Devin Deployment & Scaling

• Liderar a implementação inicial do Devin em toda a organização.

• Definir padrões de uso, diretrizes e modelos de adoção.

• Garantir que o Devin evolua de uma ferramenta para uma capacidade de engenharia padronizada.


Measurement & Governance

  • Definir métricas para medir o impacto da IA na produtividade, qualidade e confiabilidade.
  • Garantir que toda a atividade de IA seja observável, auditável e alinhada com a governança corporativa.
  • Aprimorar continuamente a orquestração com base em resultados e feedback.


Technical Leadership

  • Atuar como responsável técnico pela IA dentro do SDLC (Ciclo de Vida de Desenvolvimento de Software).
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Plataforma, DevOps, QA (Garantia da Qualidade), Segurança e Arquitetura.
  • Orientar engenheiros seniores e definir as melhores práticas.


✅ O que buscamos em você

• Liderança técnica comprovada em nível de equipe/principal.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers

description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Staff AI Engineer | AI Orchestration & SDLC Automation para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil (Porto Alegre/RS ou São Paulo/RS)


O que você vai fazer

Estamos buscando uma pessoa que irá atuar como Staff-level Engineer para projetar e gerenciar uma camada de orquestração de IA incorporada em nossos pipelines de CI/CD, transformando a IA em uma capacidade de engenharia de software controlada e escalável.

Essa função é responsável por institucionalizar agentes de IA (começando com Devin), automatizando o ciclo de vida do software de ponta a ponta, preservando a propriedade e a responsabilidade humanas.


AI Orchestration & Architecture:

Projetar e implementar uma camada de orquestração de IA integrada ao pipeline de CI/CD.

Orquestrar agentes e habilidades de IA em todas as etapas do SDLC (design, desenvolvimento, teste, refatoração).

Definir como as sessões de IA são criadas, gerenciadas, versionadas, auditadas e revisadas.


Context Engineering at Scale:

Projetar mecanismos para provisionar automaticamente o contexto por projeto, incluindo:

  • Bases de código
  • Arquitetura e documentação
  • Padrões e políticas
  • Histórico de tickets e incidentes

Garantir que a IA opere com um contexto preciso, delimitado e em conformidade desde o primeiro dia.


SDLC Automation & Ticket Flow

Automatize fluxos de trabalho a partir de tickets do Jira:

  • Ingestão e classificação de tickets
  • Criação automática de sessões de IA
  • Vinculação de contexto e definição do escopo da tarefa
  • Ciclos de revisão e aprovação humana

Habilite a rastreabilidade de ticket → código → testes → implantação.


CI/CD Integration

Incorpore a orquestração de IA em pipelines de CI/CD para:

  • Geração e modificação de código
  • Geração e manutenção automatizadas de testes
  • Revisões de PR e verificações de qualidade
  • Verificações de conformidade e segurança

Garanta que os resultados da IA sejam governados, repetíveis e mensuráveis.


Devin Deployment & Scaling

• Liderar a implementação inicial do Devin em toda a organização.

• Definir padrões de uso, diretrizes e modelos de adoção.

• Garantir que o Devin evolua de uma ferramenta para uma capacidade de engenharia padronizada.


Measurement & Governance

  • Definir métricas para medir o impacto da IA na produtividade, qualidade e confiabilidade.
  • Garantir que toda a atividade de IA seja observável, auditável e alinhada com a governança corporativa.
  • Aprimorar continuamente a orquestração com base em resultados e feedback.


Technical Leadership

  • Atuar como responsável técnico pela IA dentro do SDLC (Ciclo de Vida de Desenvolvimento de Software).
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Plataforma, DevOps, QA (Garantia da Qualidade), Segurança e Arquitetura.
  • Orientar engenheiros seniores e definir as melhores práticas.


✅ O que buscamos em você

• Sólida experiência profissional em engenharia de software.

• Liderança técnica comprovada em nível de equipe/principal.

• Sólida experiência em engenharia de plataforma, CI/CD e ferramentas internas.

• Experiência na construção de sistemas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho.

• Experiência prática na integração de agentes de IA ou LLMs em pipelines de produção.

• Experiência em ambientes regulamentados de grande escala.

• Experiência em desenvolvimento.


✅ Required skills

Platform & Orchestration

• Sistemas distribuídos e orquestração de fluxos de trabalho

• Design de pipelines CI/CD

• APIs, SDKs e frameworks de automação

• Observabilidade e auditabilidade


Applied AI

• Modelos de Aprendizagem Baseados em Lógica (LLMs), orquestração de agentes, chamada de ferramentas

• Engenharia de contexto e RAG (Random Access Group - Grupo de Ação Racional)

• Fluxos de trabalho com interação humana

• Avaliação de resultados de IA e controle de qualidade


SDLC & Quality

• Fluxos de trabalho baseados em Git

• Estratégias de teste automatizadas

• Controles de qualidade e aplicação de conformidade

• Produtividade do desenvolvedor e métricas de experiência do desenvolvedor


O que oferecemos

title: Parceiro de vendas

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Data Architect – Snowflake || Brazil/Remote
description:
Data Architect – Snowflake

Advance hands-on SQL


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

• Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa que irá atuar como Staff-level Engineer para projetar e gerenciar uma camada de orquestração de IA incorporada em nossos pipelines de CI/CD, transformando a IA em uma capacidade de engenharia de software controlada e escalável.

Essa função é responsável por institucionalizar agentes de IA (começando com Devin), automatizando o ciclo de vida do software de ponta a ponta, preservando a propriedade e a responsabilidade humanas.


AI Orchestration & Architecture:

Projetar e implementar uma camada de orquestração de IA integrada ao pipeline de CI/CD.

Orquestrar agentes e habilidades de IA em todas as etapas do SDLC (design, desenvolvimento, teste, refatoração).

  • Bases de código
  • Arquitetura e documentação
  • Padrões e políticas
  • Histórico de tickets e incidentes

Garantir que a IA opere com um contexto preciso, delimitado e em conformidade desde o primeiro dia.


SDLC Automation & Ticket Flow

  • Ingestão e classificação de tickets
  • Criação automática de sessões de IA
  • Vinculação de contexto e definição do escopo da tarefa
  • Ciclos de revisão e aprovação humana

Habilite a rastreabilidade de ticket → código → testes → implantação.


CI/CD Integration

Incorpore a orquestração de IA em pipelines de CI/CD para:

  • Geração e modificação de código
  • Geração e manutenção automatizadas de testes
  • Revisões de PR e verificações de qualidade
  • Verificações de conformidade e segurança

Garanta que os resultados da IA sejam governados, repetíveis e mensuráveis.


Devin Deployment & Scaling

• Liderar a implementação inicial do Devin em toda a organização.

• Definir padrões de uso, diretrizes e modelos de adoção.

• Garantir que o Devin evolua de uma ferramenta para uma capacidade de engenharia padronizada.


Measurement & Governance

  • Definir métricas para medir o impacto da IA na produtividade, qualidade e confiabilidade.
  • Garantir que toda a atividade de IA seja observável, auditável e alinhada com a governança corporativa.
  • Aprimorar continuamente a orquestração com base em resultados e feedback.


Technical Leadership

  • Atuar como responsável técnico pela IA dentro do SDLC (Ciclo de Vida de Desenvolvimento de Software).
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Plataforma, DevOps, QA (Garantia da Qualidade), Segurança e Arquitetura.

title: Application Support Engineer (DevOPS | Data Product Support | Brazil)
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Mission Description


We are looking for an Application Support Engineer to establish and drive operational support for Data Products within a complex, data-driven environment at world’s leading investment bank as our customer.

You will play a key role in incident management, system stability, and knowledge transfer, while working closely with global teams across the globe. The role combines production support, data analysis, and light development to ensure high availability and performance of critical data services.


What you’ll do


Core Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 application support for Data applications
  • Manage incident resolution and service restoration in production environments
  • Perform log analysis, debugging, and root cause investigations
  • Monitor and support data pipelines and data processing workflows
  • Execute and optimize SQL queries (Snowflake and other DBs)
  • Work with Unix/Linux environments for file, process, and system operations
  • Support AWS-based services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda)
  • Collaborate with global teams during operational hours

Additional Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain runbooks and support documentation
  • Support knowledge transfer activities from vendors or internal teams
  • Contribute to automation and development tasks (Python / Java scripting)
  • Assist in testing and stabilization phases of new product releases

Profile Requirements


Mandatory

  • 3+ years in Application Support / Production Support / Data Support roles
  • Strong SQL skills (Snowflake preferred)
  • Experience with Python or Java (scripting, automation, or support tooling)
  • Solid understanding of incident management (ITIL processes)
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Unix/Linux environments (CLI, file/process management)
  • Log analysis & troubleshooting
  • Good communication skills and fluent English


Nice to have

  • Exposure to ETL pipelines / data integration workflows
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Background in banking or financial sector or financial data / market data environments
  • Familiarity with:
  • Alloy
  • VLF-based query languages / Slang
  • Experience in high-availability environments


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

description:
Software Engineer - Data Platform (International Client)

About the Opportunity

Join our consultancy team and work directly with a leading insurance company in the US/UK, building their complete data platform from the ground up. We're a Florianópolis-based software development and consultancy company working with clients in the US and UK. We believe in combining the best of Brazilian tech talent with international opportunities.


Ready to level up your career with international experience? Let's talk.

description:
Decskill nasceu em 2014 como uma Empresa de Consultoria em Tecnologia da Informação e com a premissa que o seu maior ativo são as suas pessoas.   • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência como full-stack developer.
  • Experiência sólida em C#/.NET e Python .
  • Experiência sólida com React 18, TypeScript e TailwindCSS .
  • Experiência com Azure (Functions, App Service, Blob Storage, Service Bus) .

title: Business Process Analyst I
description:
Descrição da função:

1. Design e Documentação de Processos GTM

  • Documentar e aprimorar os principais processos de execução de GTM (Go-To-Market), incluindo:
  • Transferência de leads e demanda
  • Fluxo de oportunidades e negociações
  • Adoção, renovações e estratégias de expansão
  • Definir claramente responsabilidades, transições entre equipes e expectativas em cada etapa
  • Identificar lacunas de execução, pontos de atrito e inconsistências
  • Produzir mapas de processo, documentação clara e playbooks leves


2. Métricas de GTM e Visibilidade de Execução

  • Definir e padronizar um conjunto principal de métricas de execução de GTM (ex: conversão, saúde do pipeline, velocidade de negociações, renovações)
  • Alinhar definições e uso das métricas entre as equipes
  • Criar visualizações simples ou dashboards para identificar problemas e riscos na execução
  • Usar insights para recomendar melhorias específicas nos processos


3. Colaboração Multifuncional

  • Facilitar reuniões de trabalho com times de Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e Operações
  • Registrar decisões e transformá-las em documentação clara
  • Apoiar iniciativas das equipes com análises estruturadas e acompanhamento contínuo

title: SAP FI/CO (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP FI Specialist


Summary: Support and enhance Lubrizol Global SAP Procure to Pay (PTP) and Record to Report (RTR) process as a specialist,

with a primary focus on Procurement, Finance, Cost, Tax, and Localization solutions for Brazil and Mexico. Experience with CO.

Leverage deep knowledge of procurement and financial operations, tax calculation and compliance reporting within the Brazilian and Mexican legislative environments.

Engage with business stakeholders across the globe to ensure alignment and support across strategic priorities, technical domains, and standardized practices globally while ensuring that local and regional requirements are met.

Responsibilities:

Analyze, configure, test,deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement,

Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico (including Nota Fiscal, CFDI, SPED, and related regulatory reporting).

Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.

Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements, including tax calculation engines, e invoicing, and withholding tax management.

Develop standard business process design, configure, test, deploy and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions along with any bolt on for all procurement processes.

Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership, as well as with other business stakeholders.

Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes to ensure they are properly addressed.

Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.

Makes decisions applicable to level of influence in the organization. Collaborate with cross functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.

Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading, tax localization, and compliance solutions.


Horario de trabalho: Comercial

Trabalho: Remoto

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Business Systems Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

title: Application Support Engineer (DevOPS | Data Product Support | Brazil)
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Mission Description


We are looking for an Application Support Engineer to establish and drive operational support for Data Products within a complex, data-driven environment at world’s leading investment bank as our customer.

You will play a key role in incident management, system stability, and knowledge transfer, while working closely with global teams across the globe. The role combines production support, data analysis, and light development to ensure high availability and performance of critical data services.


What you’ll do


Core Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 application support for Data applications
  • Manage incident resolution and service restoration in production environments
  • Perform log analysis, debugging, and root cause investigations
  • Monitor and support data pipelines and data processing workflows
  • Execute and optimize SQL queries (Snowflake and other DBs)
  • Work with Unix/Linux environments for file, process, and system operations
  • Support AWS-based services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda)
  • Collaborate with global teams during operational hours

Additional Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain runbooks and support documentation
  • Support knowledge transfer activities from vendors or internal teams
  • Contribute to automation and development tasks (Python / Java scripting)
  • Assist in testing and stabilization phases of new product releases

Profile Requirements


Mandatory

  • 3+ years in Application Support / Production Support / Data Support roles
  • Strong SQL skills (Snowflake preferred)
  • Experience with Python or Java (scripting, automation, or support tooling)
  • Solid understanding of incident management (ITIL processes)
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Unix/Linux environments (CLI, file/process management)
  • Log analysis & troubleshooting
  • Good communication skills and fluent English


Nice to have

  • Exposure to ETL pipelines / data integration workflows
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Background in banking or financial sector or financial data / market data environments
  • Familiarity with:
  • Alloy
  • VLF-based query languages / Slang
  • Experience in high-availability environments


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Business Systems Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools

  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: SAP Technical Lead
description:
About SEW

Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and IoT-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights:

Searching for your dream job? We are a true global company that values building meaningful relationships and maintaining an enthusiastic work environment while fostering innovation and creativity. At SEW, we believe that everyone contributes to our success, and in return, we provide opportunities for them to learn new skills and build a rewarding professional career.


Summary

We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP’s core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
  • Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks
  • Define and execute integration strategies across SAP and non-SAP systems (APIs, events, middleware)
  • Design scalable, high-performance architectures that support enterprise and utility-specific requirements
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for complex initiatives, guiding development teams and solution partners
  • Ensure solutions align with SAP best practices, security standards, and long-term platform roadmaps
  • Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape
  • Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
  • Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns
  • Proven experience implementing clean core–compliant extensibility
  • Deep knowledge of SAP IS-U in utility enterprise environments
  • Experience with SAP Service Cloud V2 and SAP CX integrations
  • Solid understanding of SAP BTP, including extension, integration, and API management services
  • Strong background in system integration, performance tuning, and scalability
  • Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions
  • Utility industry experience
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Fluency in Spanish is highly required

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

Descrição da Empresa Santos e Silva Advocacia e Consultoria Jurídica é um escritório de advocacia localizado em Curitiba/PR. Com compromisso e excelência, oferecemos serviços jurídicos e consultoria de alta qualidade para atender às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Somos reconhecidos pelo profissionalismo e pelo foco em soluções jurídicas personalizadas. A empresa é movida por valores como ética, transparência e dedicação.

Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um Estagiário Jurídico para integrar nosso time e contribuir com as atividades diárias.

Somos um escritório focado em Direito Trabalhista

As principais responsabilidades incluem a redação de documentos jurídicos, acompanhamento de processos, pesquisa de jurisprudência e apoio na consultoria legal aos clientes.

Esta é uma oportunidade de estágio remota, oferecendo flexibilidade para desempenhar as atividades à distância com comprometimento e autonomia.

Qualificações

  • Direito e Consultoria Jurídica: Conhecimento básico ou em desenvolvimento sobre leis, regulamentações e práticas jurídicas, além de interesse em prestar assessoria legal.
  • Documentação Jurídica: Habilidade na elaboração de documentos jurídicos e na análise de processos com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Comunicação e Análise de Questões Legais: Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, além de capacidade de compreensão e interpretação de questões legais para oferecer soluções eficazes.
  • Será um diferencial estar cursando os últimos períodos de graduação em Direito e ter conhecimento em sistemas jurídicos digitais ou idiomas estrangeiros.

A principal função será atendimento ao público geral, atendimento via whatsapp de consultoria jurídica.

Pagaremos uma bolsa mais bonificações por desempenho podendo chegar ate 2500 de salário mensal

title: Vibecoder
description:
A Human é um ecossistema criado por criativos para criativos, que nasceu para explorar o encontro entre criatividade humana e inteligência artificial.


Nascemos da prática e estamos criando projetos reais, testando novas ferramentas e desenvolvendo novos fluxos de trabalho todos os dias dentro de empresas como Google, Nestlé e Stone.


Acreditamos que a inteligência artificial não substitui a criatividade, mas expande as possibilidades de quem cria.

Por isso, construímos um ambiente onde pessoas curiosas, inquietas e mão na massa podem explorar, testar, errar, aprender rápido e evoluir junto com o mercado (e junto com a gente).


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Criar ferramentas, automações e integrações com IA que melhorem o dia a dia dos nossos times;
  • Desenvolver workflows inteligentes para projetos criativos e campanhas;
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com times criativos, estratégicos e de produto;
  • Testar e implementar novas ferramentas (Lovable, Replit, Claude Code, GPT Codex, etc.);
  • Transformar IA em processo (não só em experimentação).


Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência construindo produtos (projetos próprios, freelas, startups ou dentro de empresas);
  • Familiaridade com vibe coding e ferramentas de AI-assisted coding;
  • Mentalidade prática: tirar ideias do papel rápido;
  • Boa comunicação para colaborar com times criativos;
  • Interesse real por criatividade, cultura e tecnologia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência criando automações ou agentes de IA;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Cursor, v0, Bolt, Replit, entre outras;
  • Já ter atuado em projetos criativos ou campanhas;
  • Interesse em explorar novas formas de criação com IA.

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Developer with 5+ years of Delphi software development experience to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Implement software changes with the awareness and sensitivity of impact on the system as a whole
  • Learn and adhere to the adopted coding standards used by the software ERP Development Team
  • Leverage Delphi experience and learn all other client development tools
  • Monitor assigned software development change requests and implement changes for requests based on priority
  • Review requirements for system changes and enhancements, analyze those requests, and translate them into necessary programming changes
  • Perform necessary designing, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation (using the Delphi IDE and any other necessary tools)


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of Delphi and SQL Server experience (FireDAC experience is a plus)
  • Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (in addition to Delphi/Object Pascal) is a plus, e.g., Java, C#, C++, etc.
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)


Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry and any related applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning and management tools such as GitHub
  • Working with AI tools within the development workflow


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AI Python Developer
description:
Role Overview

Client is seeking highly skilled Python Software Engineers to support complex data workloads and AI‑driven systems . This role is ideal for engineers who are deeply hands‑on with Python and PySpark , comfortable working in production environments , and experienced contributing to or actively engaging with open‑source communities .

This position will focus on building production‑grade APIs, scalable data pipelines, and developer tooling , while collaborating across engineering, product, and data teams.

Top Requirement: Candidates must be very strong in Python and PySpark . This is non‑negotiable and should be the primary focus during technical screening.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop production‑grade Python services and APIs supporting AI and data platforms
  • Build and optimize PySpark workloads to support large‑scale data processing
  • Contribute to AI systems and complex data pipelines in production environments
  • Develop developer tooling to streamline the software delivery lifecycle
  • Implement observability, monitoring, and performance optimization strategies
  • Practice infrastructure‑as‑code and deployment automation
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and data teams on architecture and system design
  • Participate in and contribute to technical discussions and design reviews


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong Python expertise (primary language)
  • Strong PySpark experience working with large datasets
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , primarily in Python
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field
  • Experience contributing to open‑source projects
  • Code contributions, PRs, or
  • Meaningful participation via issues, discussions, or proposals in major libraries (data science, ML, or LLM ecosystems)
  • Strong experience with Git and platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket
  • Experience developing APIs using FastAPI
  • Experience with ML / data libraries such as Scikit‑Learn, TensorFlow , or similar
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Experience with containers, orchestration systems, and serverless technologies
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical decisions clearly


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain and/or LangFlow
  • Background supporting LLM‑based or AI‑driven applications
  • Experience building data‑intensive platforms in production
  • Exposure to distributed systems and large‑scale data architectures

title: .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

Experience Level: Mid-Level+ (3+ years)


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET/.NET Core and related technologies
  • Work with SQL databases to design schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications using AWS
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in a timely manner
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices
  • Contribute to improving development processes and methodologies
  • On-call responsibilities (usually every 3 weeks)


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in software development with .NET / .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Strong exp with unit testing (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Strong exp with Kubernetes (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of CodeQL
  • Experience working with CI/CD tools and workflows
  • Solid understanding of application development principles and best practices
  • Ability to work independently in a remote team environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Exposure to ChatGPT / GPT-4 development or integration of large language models into applications


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. This engineer will contribute to the development of OrderAI, an AI-powered system that allows restaurants to take customer orders through voice interactions.

This role involves working on customer-focused products backed by LLM technologies, including real-time voice interfaces. The engineer will be able to contribute at any point in the full development cycle from the identification of system requirements and enhancements, coding the system to address these requirements, testing the system for quality control, releasing system changes, and documentation of system changes. The ideal candidate is expected to contribute to a positive engineering culture and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today processing $5 Billion in daily sales.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design, develop, and support existing systems as well as create new functionality for the OrderAI platform, with a focus on LLM-powered features, including building AI features, integrating LLM APIs, and working with prompts and voice systems
  • Write high-quality code following best practices and standards for coding, compliance, security, and performance using C#/.NET
  • Contribute to software development with an emphasis on backend design, quality, and implementation
  • Utilize the latest advances in AI and LLM technologies to improve the effectiveness of delivering business value within the AI ordering platform
  • Support and share knowledge with fellow engineers through code reviews and collaboration
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify bug fixes across systems that support AI voice ordering and backend integrations


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft technologies including C# and Azure
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Experience with queues, caching, CDNs, and other technologies used for building scalable applications
  • Demonstrated success delivering SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer-facing applications/APIs
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud environments (Azure preferred), and modern architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to work individually as well as part of a team
  • Interest in working with LLM technologies and AI-driven products


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Exposure to LLM-powered systems or AI-driven applications
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into backend systems
  • Interest in building products that leverage voice-based or conversational interfaces
  • Experience supporting real-time or event-driven systems


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:

  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.
